frozen_a4p_closure_summary.scientific_statement: No suitable public review was found among the investigated sources under the frozen W07 rules.

strategy_transition.old_strategy: POI-grounded review corpus -> retrieval -> RAG review summarization
strategy_transition.new_strategy: canonical POI knowledge corpus -> retrieval -> grounded POI RAG
strategy_transition.amendment_rationale: W07-A4P investigated 18 public sources comprising 300,536 raw rows and 186,170 unique public reviews, but zero reviews satisfied the combined frozen requirements for clear academic reuse/provenance and high-confidence mapping to the 60 canonical POIs in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Hạ Long. Continuing broad public-review acquisition has diminishing scientific value. Meanwhile, first-party review collection (W07-A3 Google Forms and W07-A4H Assisted Collection) remains scientifically valid, but human contributor recruitment volume cannot be made a blocking gate for the core W07 retrieval and RAG thesis experiments. Amending the primary W07 corpus to an evidence-grounded canonical POI knowledge corpus preserves strict provenance, avoids fabricated or AI-generated reviews, avoids unauthorized commercial scraping, and enables rigorous offline evaluation of BM25, Dense, and Hybrid RRF retrieval and grounded RAG citation.
avoids_prohibited_shortcuts: No lowering of provenance or entity-mapping standards

source_authority_and_reuse_governance.orthogonal_dimensions_rule: Source authority tier (TIER_A..TIER_D) and reuse/storage permission (OPEN_REUSABLE, RESEARCH_RESTRICTED, REFERENCE_ONLY, PROHIBITED) are strictly independent dimensions. A Tier A or Tier B official site may still have unclear or restrictive reuse/storage terms, while a Tier C open source may carry explicit open reuse rights.

two_gate_document_eligibility_rule.gate_1_canonical_mapping: Document must deterministically map to one of the 60 frozen canonical POIs in `data/evaluation/w07/w07_review_target_60_pois_v1.json` (`CANONICAL_MAPPING_OK = true`).
two_gate_document_eligibility_rule.gate_2_reuse_storage_policy: Document must have verified reuse/storage permission (`reuse_storage_class` in `{OPEN_REUSABLE, RESEARCH_RESTRICTED}` with explicit `reuse_evidence`, `attribution_requirement`, and `source_terms_checked_at`; `REUSE_STATUS_ALLOWED = true`).

OPEN_REUSABLE.description: Explicit compatible license or reuse basis allows intended primary corpus text storage and redistribution in Git, subject to recorded attribution/share-alike obligations.

RESEARCH_RESTRICTED.description: Permitted/justified only for internal academic research handling under documented constraints; raw content is stored only in git-ignored restricted storage (`data/restricted/`) and never redistributed in Git unless explicit permission allows it.

REFERENCE_ONLY.description: Useful authoritative source for factual verification/reference, but reuse/storage rights are insufficient for persistent primary corpus text. Only metadata (`source_url`, `publisher`, `source_title`, `retrieved_at`, `provenance_status`, and factual verification notes where allowed) may be retained; copied full raw text must never be committed.

PROHIBITED.description: Terms or license explicitly conflict with intended collection, storage, or research reuse; must not be ingested.

raw_text_git_policy.condition: `RAW_TEXT_COMMIT_ALLOWED = true` ONLY when `reuse_storage_class == 'OPEN_REUSABLE'` and `redistributable_in_git == true` with verified `reuse_evidence`. Otherwise, keep raw text in git-ignored `data/restricted/` (if `RESEARCH_RESTRICTED`) or retain metadata only (`REFERENCE_ONLY`). No copyrighted or public webpage may be committed to Git merely because it is publicly accessible.

overture_maps.other_themes_note: Other Overture themes may carry different license obligations such as ODbL-1.0.
overture_maps.b1_requirement: At B1, inspect record-level Overture attribution/license metadata for the exact theme (`overture_theme`) and contributing source (`overture_contributing_source`) used; never assign one blanket Overture license to every record.

openstreetmap.policy: OpenStreetMap data is governed by ODbL-1.0; record attribution (`© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0`) and share-alike obligations where applicable.

wikidata.policy: Wikidata structured data statements are licensed under CC0-1.0 (Public Domain Dedication).

wikimedia_wikipedia_wikivoyage_text.policy: Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, and Wikimedia prose/text must NOT be collapsed into Wikidata CC0 semantics; text reuse must preserve the applicable Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike license, author/revision history link, and source-specific share-alike requirements.

decision_rules.ACCEPT_PRIMARY_CORPUS: `CANONICAL_MAPPING_OK == true` AND `reuse_storage_class == 'OPEN_REUSABLE'` with verified license/reuse evidence.
decision_rules.REFERENCE_ONLY: `CANONICAL_MAPPING_OK == true` AND `reuse_storage_class == 'REFERENCE_ONLY'` (metadata/verification reference only; no persistent raw text corpus storage).
decision_rules.REJECT: `CANONICAL_MAPPING_OK == false` OR `reuse_storage_class == 'PROHIBITED'` OR missing/unverified reuse evidence.

first_party_reviews.policy: Genuine first-party reviews collected via W07-A3 or W07-A4H may be incorporated later as an optional supplementary layer without blocking primary POI-knowledge retrieval/RAG evaluation.

public_reviews.policy: W07-A4P is closed with 0 accepted primary reviews; auxiliary anonymized ABSA datasets remain strictly separated from the primary POI corpus.

openclaw_and_jev_roadmap.openclaw_future_role: Future orchestration of approved fresh-data and source-refresh workflows after core retrieval/RAG is stable.
openclaw_and_jev_roadmap.jev_future_role: Future enhancement evaluated only where it provides measurable value to GoMate.

RQ_W07_RETRIEVAL.question: Which retrieval strategy most effectively retrieves relevant, provenance-grounded POI information for Vietnamese travel queries over the GoMate canonical POI knowledge corpus?

RQ_W07_RAG.question: Can grounded generation using retrieved authoritative POI evidence answer travel questions with higher factual support and citation correctness than generation without retrieval?

human_relevance_ground_truth_policy.annotators: Project researchers / team members following frozen annotation guidelines

proposed_corpus_thresholds.former_review_threshold_reference: 60 POIs x 5 reviews = 300 reviews (superseded for primary W07 gate)
proposed_corpus_thresholds.no_document_fabrication_rule: Do not fabricate or synthetically pad documents merely to hit a numerical threshold; report exact empirical coverage per city and category.

tiers.name: Official POI / venue website
tiers.description: Official website or digital publication operated by the attraction, museum, hotel, or venue. High factual authority, but requires explicit reuse/storage verification before primary corpus ingestion.

tiers.name: Government / tourism-authority site
tiers.description: National, provincial, or municipal tourism authority portals and heritage administration pages. Requires explicit reuse/storage verification before primary corpus ingestion.

tiers.name: Open-data / open-license geographic or tourism source
tiers.description: OpenStreetMap (ODbL-1.0), Overture Maps (theme- and source-specific: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 / Apache-2.0 / CC0-1.0 for Places; other themes may carry ODbL-1.0), Wikidata structured data (CC0-1.0), and Wikimedia/Wikipedia/Wikivoyage text (CC-BY-SA-4.0 / CC-BY-SA-3.0 with attribution/share-alike).

tiers.name: Other research-usable public source
tiers.description: Publicly accessible travel/cultural reference documents with verified reuse rights, clear provenance, and non-conflicting factual claims.

source_hierarchy.conflict_resolution_rule: Prefer higher authority tiers (TIER_A > TIER_B > TIER_C > TIER_D) when factual claims conflict; never treat low-authority social posts as canonical factual evidence, and never treat authority tier alone as permission to store or redistribute raw text.

allowed_claims: Review-based W07 corpus construction was not feasible under the frozen constraints and available investigated sources.
The project therefore adopts an evidence-grounded POI knowledge corpus as the primary W07 retrieval corpus.
No suitable public review was found among the investigated sources under the frozen W07 rules.
forbidden_claims: No usable tourism reviews exist anywhere.
